Hi, Doctor. Thank you for seeing me. Um, well, I guess I'm here because... I've been having just a little bit of trouble at work. I'm a cashier, and... it's probably nothing major, really, but lately I keep sort of getting stuck doing things at the register that don't exactly fit the moment? 

Like, I'll catch myself tapping the scanner in a little pattern, or... or I might just freeze with my hand hovering over the cash drawer while a customer is waiting. I feel just terrible making them wait, I really do. It actually got me written up last week, which is why I thought I should come in. I always try to do a good job and be a good employee, you know? I hope I'm explaining this okay... does that make sense?
When you catch yourself tapping in that pattern, is there a specific thought or urge that makes you feel like you have to do it?

Oh, um... no, not really. I hope I'm answering this right, but... I don't think there's a specific thought behind it. It's not like I'm telling myself I *have* to do it, or... or thinking about anything in particular. My hand just sort of... does it? 

It's probably just a silly little nervous habit, really. I'm trying very hard to pay better attention so I can stop, I promise. I'd never do something like that on purpose to bother the customers or hold up the line. Does that... does that answer your question okay?
When you freeze with your hand hovering like that, are you fully aware of what is happening around you?

Well, um... yes, I think so. I mean, like I was saying before about getting stuck over the drawer... I can usually hear the customer sighing or shifting their feet. So I'm not, you know, totally checked out or anything. 

It's just... my hand just won't finish the movement right then. It's like I just pause at the wrong time, and the action just doesn't fit the moment anymore. I really hope you don't think I'm doing it to be rude or ignore them. I know I mentioned getting written up for it last week, and I'm just so embarrassed about that, because I really do care about my job and the customers. I'm trying my absolute best to stay focused so it doesn't happen again. 

Is that... am I explaining it the right way for you?
